import numpy as np
# stair + tri-star geometry
riser=0.197 # m max IRC
going=0.254 # m min IRC
wheel_d=0.150 # m Superlift solid rubber
wheel_r=wheel_d/2
# tri-star: three wheel centres on radius Rc from main axle; choose Rc so cluster spans riser
# typical: wheel centres 120 deg apart, Rc ~ 0.11 m gives overall cluster diameter ~ 2*(Rc+wheel_r)=0.37m
Rc=0.11
m_load=60.0
m_truck=12.0 # assumed steel tri-star truck tare between 6kg Alu and 18kg Superlift
m_tot=m_load+m_truck
W=m_tot*9.81
# Tilted hand-truck: operator carries fraction f of weight at handles, wheels carry rest.
# On stairs at ~45deg lean, vertical load splits; assume operator supports ~35% vertical.
f_op=0.35
# Pulling up one step: work = W*riser. Pull distance along slope per step ~ sqrt(riser^2+going^2)/cos(lean correction)
# Simplify: operator force along incline needed = W*sin(stair_angle)*share + rolling/cluster pivot loss factor k
stair_angle=np.arctan2(riser,going) # rad
k_loss=1.25 # pivot sliding + tyre scrub
F_pull=W*np.sin(stair_angle)*f_op*k_loss + 20 # +20 N guidance
# Cluster torque about main axle when pivoting on one stopped wheel: T = (W_per_side/2)*Rc roughly
T_per_side=(W/2)*Rc
# Check wheel contact: cluster overall radius must exceed riser for smooth handover
cluster_R=Rc+wheel_r
print(f"stair_angle_deg {np.degrees(stair_angle):.1f}")
print(f"total weight N {W:.0f} (~{W/9.81:.0f} kg)")
print(f"energy per step J {W*riser:.0f}")
print(f"operator pull N {F_pull:.0f}")
print(f"cluster radius m {cluster_R:.3f} vs riser m {riser:.3f} ratio {cluster_R/riser:.2f}")
print(f"pivot torque per side N m {T_per_side:.1f}")
# descent: holding force similar magnitude, must be sustained not lifted
print(f"descent hold N ~ {F_pull*0.9:.0f}")
# flat rolling: rolling resistance small wheels on hard floor Crr~0.02
print(f"flat push N ~ {W*0.02+10:.0f}")

print(f"Wtot={Wtot:.1f} N theta={math.degrees(theta):.1f} deg slope={slope:.1f} N Ttot={Ttot:.1f} Nm Tperside={Tperside:.1f} Nm")

proposal.author: Manager
proposal.text: Manual tri-star hand truck for one courier with 60 kg parcel v2. Load chain in order is parcel to folding toe-plate to one-piece twin-tube backbone with clip-on transverse brace to main axle to two tri-star clusters to step, and brake chain is grips to cable to disc caliper plus tooth park pin to cluster plate. Side view layout from front to rear is toe-plate low front, backrest and backbone with brace middle, tri-star clusters low rear, telescoping U-loop grips high rear. Operating directionality is pulling backward uphill as leading end and lowering forward downhill as trailing end, cluster pivots on stopped lead wheel with no free back-drive when lever released. Support is twin-tube backbone with toe-plate and backrest plus clip-on brace, restrain is webbing strap over backrest capped at eye level, flat motion is paired wheels rolling as fixed cart, stairs is tri-star clusters, limit is spring-applied dead-man levers with disc plus tooth park pin with cable along backbone with slack loop, collapse is unclip brace plus toe folds up plus handle slides down with fold only when brake locked and parcel removed, van mount is flat on floor against sidewall strapped to tie-down with brace alongside. Rejected archetype is powered crawler and large single-wheel cart. concepts=['C22', 'C23', 'C2', 'C1', 'C7', 'C13']

closure.chief_decision: Manual tri-star hand truck for 60 kg parcel: twin-tube backbone with clip-on brace, strap, paired-wheel flat roll, tri-star climb, spring-applied dead-man disc plus tooth park lock, folding toe plus sliding handle, van floor strap. Total 66.7 kg on stairs, tare 6.70 kg suitcase lift, folded 730x380x190 mm for 52.7 L with 390 mm door clearance, stress 51.1 MPa for factor 5.40 static 3.60 with impact, braced 13.8 mm, stair 209 N pull 188 N hold in 67.0 N m lock. Bench test with hardware: one-tired-hand lever release force and tooth engagement reliability on 197 mm riser both directions.

records: cycle 1: Nothing selected, tri-star cluster with dead-man lock plus telescoping handle and folding toe-plate is leading direction, numbers that stand are 60 kg parcel with 589 N weight, 116 J per 197 mm riser (E22), 209 N pull and 188 N hold (E23) versus 161 N tip-hold (E34), 66.5 kg total (E41), folded 730 by 380 by 190 mm for 52.7 L (E42) fitting 1120 by 1235 mm door (E36), still open are Mara Voss formal Support and Restrain concepts and stair stress, Kenji Tanaka plus Elena Ruiz locked-brake torque proof, Tomas Lind latch interface, all owed in cycle 2.

cycle 2: Proposal v1 selects backbone C22, strap C23, roll C2, tri-star C1, dead-man C7, fold C13; numbers that stand are 66.5 kg total (E73), 51.1 MPa for factor 5.40 (E74), 209 N pull and 188 N hold (E23) with 67.0 N m lock (E51), folded 730 by 380 by 190 mm for 52.7 L (E42) with 390 mm door clearance (E76); still open are cross-brace stiffness for 0.11 m whip (E71) owed by Mara Voss with Tomas Lind, and member votes on v1 plus bench test of lever release and tooth engagement.

cycle 3: Proposal v2 selects twin-tube backbone with strap, paired-wheel roll, tri-star climb, dead-man disc plus tooth lock, and folding toe plus sliding handle with clip-on brace; numbers that stand are 66.7 kg total with brace, 51.1 MPa for factor 5.40 static, 209 N pull and 188 N hold locked by 67.0 N m, braced deflection 13.8 mm, folded 730 by 380 by 190 mm for 52.7 L with 390 mm door clearance; still open are votes on v2 by all members and bench test of one-tired-hand lever release and tooth engagement owed by Elena Ruiz with Kenji Tanaka and Mara Voss.

Mara Voss, Kenji Tanaka, Elena Ruiz, Tomas Lind, v2 corrects v1 where your evidence required it because v1 still stated the flexible frame. In plain words the backbone stays one piece and a removable brace halves its free length to fingertip stiffness while still fitting flat for stow. The numbers that decide it are tip whip 0.11 m from the tip deflection per tube 1p1m backbone (E71) falling to 13.8 mm from the braced tip deflection halved span (E85), added brace mass 0.2 kg keeping lift to 65.7 N from the tare lift with clip-on brace (E86) against 63.8 N from the folded tare weight for one-person lift (E66), like one suitcase, so total lifted is 60 kg parcel plus 6.5 kg tare plus 0.2 kg brace for 66.7 kg against the 60 kg parcel rule.

In plain words the slope now lives in the lock not in the hands, and the mounts carry it with large margin like a spanner on a car nut. The numbers that decide it are stair pull 209 N and hold 188 N from the tri-star climb over steps cluster rotation and operator pull estimate (E23) far above the 111 N sustained limit I take from Carts Push Pull Guidelines (E77), carried instead by 67.0 N m total torque needing 1.40 kN clamp from the locked cluster holding torque and disc clamp on steep stair (E51), with axle shear 21.3 MPa from the axle torsion calc (E88) and pin shear 5.86 MPa from the pin shear calc (E89), and lift energy 116 J per riser from the parcel lift energy (E22) like a shopping bag to a counter.

In plain words the stow stays a suitcase through a domestic door and the van strap only holds the light tare while the fold can never tension the brake. The numbers that decide it are folded 730 by 380 by 190 mm for 52.7 L from the folded envelope volume (E42) leaving 390 mm clearance from the door width clearance folded length (E76), forward restraint 51.0 N from the forward restraint force on folded truck (E67), and flat push 24.0 N from the tri-star climb over steps cluster rotation and operator pull estimate (E23) passing sustained while stair pull fails, so I answer Elena Ruiz, Mara Voss and Kenji Tanaka as correct on v1 and now corrected in v2 except the one-tired-hand lever and tooth bench test which needs built hardware and is named for synthesis not left open.

cycle 4: Proposal v2 decided is twin-tube backbone with strap, paired-wheel roll, tri-star climb, dead-man disc plus tooth lock, folding toe plus sliding handle with clip-on brace; numbers that stand are sixty six point seven kilograms total with sixty five point seven newtons tare lift (E86), fifty one point one megapascals for factor five point four zero static three point six zero with impact (E70, E74), two hundred nine newtons pull one hundred eighty eight newtons hold locked by sixty seven point zero newton metres (E23, E51), braced thirteen point eight millimetres (E85), folded seven hundred thirty by three hundred eighty by one hundred ninety millimetres for fifty two point seven litres (E42) with three hundred ninety millimetres clearance (E76); still open is nothing except hardware bench test of lever release and tooth engagement owed to hardware not to members.
